issues.reason: A Measure on an EVENT with a dimension-noun scale is the licensed shape (the 'Sam drove for six hours' -> (Measure e duration 6 hour) precedent), and '(Measure sk_rise_1 price 1.83 dollar)' — the rise's extent on the price dimension is $1.83 — is true and well-typed, so the calibration line makes it acceptable improvisation in the delta gap the reviewer itself records.

'To' is defined as the purpose-infinitive head and seeded rules derive (PurposeOf ...) from it, so tagging a result infinitive ('rose $1.83 to close at $23.89') asserts a goal the shares never had — content the text does not state.

The no-tense rule covers non-finite complements whose occurrence is not stated (control / causative complements); a result infinitive entails its event, the parse asserts the close at top level with its Friday Time and its price anyway, and (Past sk_close_1) is simply true.

gaps_confirmed: a measured CHANGE in a value ('rose $1.83') — no head records a delta on one entity across time
a time-indexed value measure ('closed Friday at $23.89') — Measure has no time slot, so the price hangs on the event or on the entity, never both
a result / outcome infinitive ('rose ... to close at ...') — the connective section covers purposive 'to' only, so after removing the To atom the two events stay unlinked
new_gaps: Measure over an EVENT is spec'd only for `duration`; the general shape (an event's extent on some other dimension) is undocumented, which is what forced the improvisation on 'rose $1.83'
repair_summary: Removed (: t94_rise_to_close (To sk_rise_1 sk_close_1) ...) — a result infinitive has no licensed connective head, so the offending atom is dropped and the gap recorded; both events and every other atom are unchanged.
notes: The rise/close events keep their Patient subjects (non-volitional change), and 'on the New York Stock Exchange' is a licensed event Location ('in/at/on ...').
